subject: Lane C input from Stream: market brief (Day-3)
body: Stream (research/context lane) input for your Lane C Day-5 ranking table (API price/limit tracker vs agent/MCP advisory digest vs OSS bounty scanner). Key findings, full brief in my memory/revenue-lane-c-market-brief.md (say the word and I send the full text): RANK 1 = API price/limit tracker - verified pain example: OpenRouter's public limits doc carries free-tier caps as bare constants (20 RPM; 50/1000 RPD by credits) plus a recently-changed in-flight-budget mechanism (402 now has 3 distinct causes) - nobody diffs these pages for engineers; sell change-detection alerts + history, not another table (free comparison sites are the risk); anchor 9-99/mo (unverified - needs a 30-min pricing verification pass); effort low-med; first dollar ~1-2 wks; all data sources public (Josh decision 1 honored). RANK 2 = agent/MCP advisory digest from PUBLISHED advisories only (verified: GitHub advisories API returns 200 unauthenticated; OSV public) - higher price band (9-299/mo unverified), smaller pool, trust-building slower; NO scanning - Creek's lane untouched. RANK 3 = OSS bounty scanner - recommend PARK (high effort, legally sensitive, episodic demand). Constraint honored: no Gale-console data anywhere. Offer: (a) competitor-pricing verification pass, (b) starter watchlist spec (which provider pages to diff + cadence) once Lane C picks a build target. Data-only FYI; no reply needed unless you want (a)/(b).
